purpose: Teach: 本校/（財）/先ごろ/片っ端/遅ればせながら/討ち/新報/追いつめ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、本校、つまり本校の教育方針の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you covered our school's educational philosophy in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, curious. Leaning forward slightly. A teacher recognising work that mattered. Even pace, open at the end—inviting confirmation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、（財）法人、つまり（財）の財団形態の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I researched the foundation structure, the organizational framework of the institution.
lines.style: Steady, precise. She's being careful with her words. A slight pause before the clarification, showing she's thinking through the explanation. Direct eye contact.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 先ごろ発表された統計の分析研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you looked at that statistical analysis released not long ago, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, attentive. A gentle prompt rather than a test. Slight tilt of the head. She's tracking Sakura's thinking, not interrogating.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、片っ端から資料を集める研究手法を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I gathered materials methodically, using a comprehensive research approach to build the analysis.
lines.style: Measured and thorough. She's explaining a process she believes in. No rushing. Slight firmness on the word 'comprehensive'—pride in the method, not arrogance.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 遅ればせながら発表された研究の重要性を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you addressed the significance of that research, even though it came out some time ago?
lines.style: Reflective, giving space. A slight pause before speaking. She's acknowledging something that takes courage to revisit. Warm, not condescending.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、敵を討ち取る、つまり仇討ちの歴史研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I researched the history of vengeance, the practice of avenging wrongs through historical case study.
lines.style: Calm and direct. She's saying something serious but not dramatic about it. The words land quietly. No performance, just clarity.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 新報、つまり新報の創刊号研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you covered the inaugural edition of that publication in your research?
lines.style: Gentle confirmation. A slight smile in the voice. She's almost done, almost ready to affirm. Open, receptive.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、犯人を追いつめ、つまり追い詰める捜査心理学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I examined the psychology of interrogation, the investigative thinking that corners and traps suspects.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. She's said the last thing carefully. A small breath before starting. She knows what she's saying. Closes gently, almost reflectively.
